paragraphs.text: A self required working plugins of DeepseekHarness
# dsh-plugins

A pnpm-workspace monorepo of DeepSeek Harness
plugin bundles. Each directory under `packages/` is an

independent, self-contained
dsh bundle you can install into a profile on any machine — plain JavaSc

ript,
no build step, so no `allowBuilds` authorization is needed.
## Packages
| Package | Purpose |
| `packages/workspace-env` | Keep uv / Go toolchain cache writes inside the `workspace-write` sandbo

x (workspace-local `.uv-cache/`, `.go-cache/`) |
| `packages/airboard` | Read-only AirBoard viewer f
or the web GUI: a right-Sidebar tab over a host-side `/airboard` proxy (configurable service address

+ token) |
| `packages/feishu-gateway` | Feishu (Lark) bot gateway: bind a p2p bot chat to a worksp
ace session — messages run tasks, questions/approvals round-trip as interactive cards |

## Install via the plugin market (Discover)

commit. Requires a dsh with the *Custom plugin i

ndexes* experimental bundle
turned on.

## Adding a new plugin

1. `mkdir packages/<name> && cd packages/<name>`
2. Copy the layout from `packages/workspace-env`: `

package.json` (with the
`dsh.bundle.patch` field), the plugin entry (`index.js`), its
`cordis.patch.

yml`, and a `README.md`. For a plugin with web-GUI UI, copy
`packages/airboard` instead — it adds th

e browser half (`client.js`,
`dsh.client`, `locale/`, `icon.svg`).
3. Keep dependencies to dsh **pee

r** packages (`@deepseek-ai/*`); no runtime
npm dependencies — configuration goes through ordinary e

npm dependencies — configuration goes through ordinary environment layers.
